topic: Age-related macular degeneration: wavy lines, Amsler grid check

youtube.title: Straight lines look wavy? 3 signs after 50 👁️ #Shorts
youtube.description:
Straight lines look wavy? 3 signs of age-related macular degeneration to check after 50.
நேர் கோடுகள் வளைந்து தெரிகிறதா? 50 வயதுக்கு மேல் கவனியுங்கள்

• The macula is the centre of the retina; it gives sharp central vision for reading and faces.
• Sign 1: straight lines (door frames, tiles, text) look bent or wavy.
• Sign 2: a blurry or dark spot in the centre of vision. Sign 3: faces and small print get harder to see.
• Amsler grid check: hold a square grid at reading distance, wear your reading glasses, cover one eye, look at the centre dot. Note any wavy, blurred or missing lines. Repeat with the other eye.
• Studies show AMD is a leading cause of vision loss in older adults; smoking raises the risk.
• See an eye specialist urgently if lines suddenly turn wavy or a new dark spot appears.

gmb.text: Do straight lines look wavy? After 50, watch for three signs of age-related macular degeneration: straight lines such as door frames or text look bent, a blurry or dark spot appears in the centre of vision, and faces or small print get harder to see. The macula is the centre of the retina and gives sharp central vision. You can do a simple Amsler grid check at home: cover one eye, look at the centre dot of a square grid, and note any wavy or missing lines, then check the other eye. Not smoking and regular eye checks help. See an eye specialist urgently if lines suddenly turn wavy or a new dark spot appears. Book an eye test on WhatsApp: 044 4356 9998

threads.text: Simple check for anyone over 50: cover one eye and look at a square grid (or a tiled floor). Do the straight lines look wavy or does a spot look missing? That can be a sign of macular degeneration and needs an eye test. Have you or your parents ever tried this? #EyeHealth #AMD
